description: Class representing a text range within a presentation shape's text frame.

AddHyperlink.description: Adds a hyperlink to the current text range.

params.description: The link address.
params.name: link

params.description: The screen tip text.
params.name: screenTipText

params.description: Name of a bookmark
params.name: bookmarkName

returns.description: returns null if the range spans more than one paragraph or params are invalid.

AddHyperlink.signature: AddHyperlink(link: string, screenTipText: string, bookmarkName: string): ApiHyperlink

AddText.description: Adds a text to the specified position. The current range is expanded to include the added text.

params.description: The text that will be added.
params.name: text

params.description: The position where the text will be added ("before" or "after" the range specified).
params.name: position

returns.description: returns true if the text was successfully added.

Delete.description: Deletes the contents of the current text range.

returns.description: returns false if the range is empty.

ExpandTo.description: Returns a new range that spans both this range and the given range. The current range is not changed.

Find.description:
Finds the first occurrence of the given text within this range and returns it as a new ApiTextRange.
Returns null if the text is not found.

params.description: Text to search for.
params.name: findWhat

params.description: 1-based position within this range to start searching from.
params.name: after

params.description: Case-sensitive search.
params.name: matchCase

params.description: Match whole words only.
params.name: wholeWords

Find.signature: Find(findWhat: string, after?: number, matchCase?: boolean, wholeWords?: boolean): ApiTextRange | null

GetAllParagraphs.description: Returns all Paragraph objects within this range.

GetEndPos.description: Returns the end position of the current range.

GetParagraph.description:
Returns the paragraph at the given index within this range.
Returns null if the index is out of bounds.

GetRange.description: Returns a new ApiTextRange that represents a sub-range of the current range.

params.description: Start offset (0-based) relative to the beginning of this range.
params.name: start

params.description: End offset relative to the beginning of this range. -1 means the end of this range.
params.name: rangeEnd

GetRange.signature: GetRange(start?: number, rangeEnd?: number): ApiTextRange | null

GetStartPos.description: Returns the start position of the current range.

GetText.description: Returns the text content of the range. Paragraph breaks are represented as "\r".

params.description: Options for formatting the returned text.
params.name: options

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include mathematical expressions or not.
params.name: options_Math

params.description: Defines how the line separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r".
params.name: options_NewLineSeparator

params.description: Defines how the table cell separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\t".
params.name: options_TableCellSeparator

params.description: Defines how the table row separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r\n".
params.name: options_TableRowSeparator

params.description: Defines how the paragraph separator will be specified in the resulting string. Any symbol can be used. The default separator is "\r\n".
params.name: options_ParaSeparator

params.description: Defines how the tab will be specified in the resulting string (does not apply to numbering). Any symbol can be used. The default symbol is "\t".
params.name: options_TabSymbol

GetText.signature: GetText(options?: object, options_Math?: boolean, options_NewLineSeparator?: string, options_TableCellSeparator?: string, options_TableRowSeparator?: string, options_ParaSeparator?: string, options_TabSymbol?: string): string

GetTextPr.description: Returns the merged text properties of the entire range.

IntersectWith.description: Returns a new range that is the intersection of this range and the given range. The current range is not changed.

MoveCursorToPos.description: Moves a cursor to the specified position within the current range.

params.description: The desired cursor position.
params.name: pos

Replace.description: Replaces all occurrences of the specified text within this range.

params.description: Text to search for.
params.name: findWhat

params.description: Replacement text.
params.name: replaceWith

params.description: Case-sensitive search.
params.name: matchCase

params.description: Match whole words only.
params.name: wholeWords

Replace.signature: Replace(findWhat: string, replaceWith: string, matchCase?: boolean, wholeWords?: boolean): ApiTextRange

Select.description: Selects the text range in the editor.

SetBold.description: Sets bold formatting for the contents of the current text range.

SetCaps.description: Specifies that any lowercase characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.

params.description: Specifies if the Range contents are displayed capitalized or not.
params.name: isCaps

SetColor.description: Sets the text color of the current range.

SetDoubleStrikeout.description: Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.

SetEndPos.description: Sets the end position of the current range.

params.description: End position.
params.name: pos

SetFontFamily.description: Sets the font family for the current TextRange.

params.description: The font family or families used for the current text Range.
params.name: fontFamily

SetFontSize.description: Sets the font size of the characters in the current text Range.

params.description: The text size value measured in half-points (1/144 of an inch).
params.name: fontSize

SetHighlight.description: Specifies a highlighting color which is applied as a background to the contents of the current Range.

SetItalic.description: Sets the italic property to the text character.

SetSmallCaps.description:
Specifies that all the lowercase letter characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital
letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current Range are displayed capitalized two points smaller or not.
params.name: isSmallCaps

SetSpacing.description: Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.

params.description: The value of the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: spacing

SetStartPos.description: Sets the start position of the current range.

params.description: Start position.
params.name: pos

SetStrikeout.description: Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with a single horizontal line through the range center.

SetText.description: Replaces all text content with the given string. Use "\r" to separate paragraphs.

params.description: New text value.
params.name: text

SetTextPr.description: Sets the text properties to the current text range.

params.description: The text properties that will be applied to the current range.
params.name: textPr

SetUnderline.description:
Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character
(less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).

params.description: Specifies if the contents of the current Range are displayed underlined or not.
params.name: isUnderline

SetVertAlign.description:
Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the Range contents in relation to the default appearance of the Range text:
**"baseline"** - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned by the default text baseline.
**"subscript"** - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned below the default text baseline.
**"superscript"** - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned above the default text baseline.

params.description: The vertical alignment type applied to the text contents.
params.name: type

ToHtml.description: Converts the text range to HTML.

params.description: The HTML conversion options.
params.name: options
